messages:
Maria Lopez: AM check — quick triage. Queue volume 48 (+6 since last shift). Top flags:
- Known: embeddings failures for model-x after rollback (errors: 502 / timeout). Seen in dedicated EU pool.
- Billing: 3 chargeback tickets awaiting macros.
Please ack and self-assign. Pushing two small macro edits to /macros/billing-refund, need a quick review.

Sam: ack, grabbing the emb failures. Any recent deploys?

Maria Lopez: Nope, no prod deploys in the last 2 hours. We did a canary rollback on model-x at 02:15 UTC.

Priya: I can look at the macro edits, ping me the PR.

Diego: taking two high-latency tickets (T-4021, T-4023). Will also glance at redis / kv cache errors.

Sam: here's a sample log from the embed worker:
```
enc-embed-01 | 2026-03-17T10:12:45Z | request_id=abc123 | error=grpc: deadline exceeded
enc-embed-01 | 2026-03-17T10:12:46Z | upstream=model-x-review | kv_cache_hit=false
```

Maria Lopez: thanks. Filing an ops ticket for infra to check network egress to model hosting.

incident-bot: Incident created: IN-2026-034 — "model-x embed timeouts" — severity: S2 — assigned: eng-infra

Priya: PR posted — https://github.com/redwood-inference/support-macros/pull/56 — diff is tiny, updated billing-refund macro subject and tokens.

Sam: repro steps for embeds:
1) send batch of 64 short texts
2) model-x jwt rotation triggers
3) observe 502/timeout within 10s

Maria Lopez: If infra can confirm no network change, we'll roll model-x back to v1.9.2 today. For now, add macro note: "If embeds failing, ask customer to retry after 10s and open support link"

Priya: updated macro snippet:
```
Title: Billing refund — duplicate charge
Body: Hi {{customer_name}},
We see a duplicate charge for {{invoice_id}}. We've queued a refund and will confirm within 3-5 business days. If this was due to a transient error, please retry the operation after 10 seconds.
```

Diego: will assign T-4021 to infra once incident ticket is linked.

Sam: temporary patch: throttling batches to 32 reduces failures in my local repro.

Maria Lopez: great. Pls mark any ticket you touch with tag `triage:midshift` and add short note. Back in ~2h for next check. :thumbsup:

Priya: :eyes:

Sam: :thumbsup:

Diego: on it.
